biography:
Patrick Huang, a highly respected and dynamic senior executive in the construction industry with over 26 years of proven expertise. With a track record of successfully managing over $5 billion in diverse construction projects across commercial, residential, and industrial sectors, Patrick has become a recognized leader in the industry.

Having excelled in a range of senior leadership roles, including Sr. Preconstruction Manager, Procurement Manager, Project Manager, Project Superintendent, and Project Engineer, Patrick brings unparalleled insight and experience to every project he leads.

Patrick is known for his exceptional skill set and leadership in key areas such as:

• Preconstruction Planning & Feasibility Studies – Laying the foundation for successful projects from the start.
• Procurement, Risk Management & Contract Negotiation – Expertly navigating the complexities of contracts and ensuring optimal project outcomes.
• Collaborative Communication – Building effective, transparent relationships that drive success.
• Leadership & Business Relationship Development – Leading teams and forging lasting partnerships that fuel growth.
• Mentoring & People Development – Investing in the next generation of industry professionals through coaching and guidance.
• Successful Project Delivery – Expertise in delivering projects through various methods, including design-build, on-time and on-budget.
• Hands-On Construction Knowledge – A deep, comprehensive understanding of every aspect of the construction process.
• Planning, Scheduling, & Budgeting – Mastering the critical elements that ensure projects are executed efficiently and cost-effectively.

Throughout his career, Patrick Huang has earned a reputation for excellence, consistently delivering successful projects and shaping the future of the construction industry with his strategic vision, leadership, and commitment to quality.
